The FloPlast RY1W round pipe branch is a crucial component for efficient rainwater drainage systems. Constructed from high-quality uPVC, this 68mm white pipe branch offers a tough, durable, and lightweight solution for easy installation. Ideal for both new-build installations and refurbishment projects across various building types. The double socket design ensures secure connections, while its compatibility with most 68mm downpipe systems makes it a versatile choice for professional plumbers and roofers seeking reliable guttering components.
